name: Masala Drama (Commercial)
description: High-emotion, multi-generational family saga with intense drama, romance, and conflict.

chapters.title: The Grand Function
chapters.description: Start with a massive wedding or festival, introducing the sprawling family.

chapters.title: The Hidden Secret
chapters.description: Reveal a scandalous family secret that threatens their reputation (Izzat).

chapters.title: The Rebellious Heart
chapters.description: The protagonist falls for someone inappropriate or chooses an unconventional path.

chapters.title: The Patriarch's Decree
chapters.description: The head of the family lays down a harsh rule or ultimatum.

chapters.title: The Melodramatic Confrontation
chapters.description: A high-stakes emotional argument, preferably in front of relatives.

chapters.title: The Tragic Misunderstanding
chapters.description: A plot twist that separates the protagonist from their allies/lover.

chapters.title: The Sacrificial Lamb
chapters.description: Someone makes a huge sacrifice for the sake of the family's honor.

chapters.title: The Return of the Prodigal
chapters.description: An exiled character returns, bringing new information or wealth.

chapters.title: The Ultimate Betrayal
chapters.description: The true villain within the family is exposed.

chapters.title: The Climax at the Mandap
chapters.description: Everything comes to a head at another major family gathering.

chapters.title: The Tearful Reunion
chapters.description: Forgiveness is sought and granted; families reunite.

chapters.title: The Happy Ending
chapters.description: A new generation begins; tradition and modernity find a balance.
